name: ripcord
description: Fast, clean audio extractor for Spotify and YouTube powered by yt-dlp & FFmpeg

scripts.check:syntax: node --check server.js && node --check public/script.js && node -e "require('fs').readdirSync('src').forEach(f => f.endsWith('.js') && require('child_process').execSync('node --check src/' + f))"
scripts.check:icons: python3 scripts/check-icons.py 2>/dev/null || python scripts/check-icons.py 2>/dev/null || pipx run --spec "fonttools[brotli,woff]" python scripts/check-icons.py

author: Webjuniors & Friends
